content:
The analysis failed due to schema mismatches in assumptions and significant calculation errors in the total margin values.
The test_template_preservation_and_schema failed because data['analysis']['assumptions'] contained 7 unexpected items (e.g., 'analysis_mode_filter', 'decision_threshold_usd'). In test_rows_and_order, panel keys were mismatched, with 'runs_per_year' fields incorrectly present while 'network_tier' was missing. Crucially, test_totals_and_decision failed with a large margin discrepancy: close(26185.96, 1090.76) returned False. Finally, test_summary_requirements failed because the formatted string '26,185.96' (with comma) was not found in the raw text output.
